episode.episode_title: Microsoft 365 is back. What the outage tells us about resilience
episode.episode_description: Microsoft says core workplace services have recovered. The underlying technical disruption reveals practical vulnerabilities in how organisations depend on cloud collaboration tools.

selected_story.headline: Microsoft 365 services restored after worldwide disruption
selected_story.source_title: Microsoft restores service to Outlook and Teams after global outage

short.title: Microsoft 365 services restored after worldwide disruption
short.description:
Email, calendar and collaboration outages can halt routine work at organisations that otherwise have functioning computers and networks. The incident affected government and commercial operations, while Downdetector recorded reports from more than 70 countries and territories.

Read Sapiver Forge Daily Brief: https://suite.sapiverpress.co.uk/daily-brief/
short.script: Microsoft says Outlook, Teams and other affected services have recovered after a major disruption linked to a technical network-capacity change. That is not the same as a cyberattack. If your business depends on one email and collaboration platform, what is your independent backup? This is Sapiver Forge Daily Intelligence.
